capability.name: Artifact Manager
capability.author: Carlos Daniel X.M.S.
capability.description: Gerenciador local de validação, status, paths, registry entry e plano de lifecycle de artifacts CDXMS.

implementation_audit.source_base: remote feat/create-ecosystem-core updated with AM + DR, remodeled for AM -> DR orchestration
implementation_audit.scope: artifact lifecycle planning plus controlled local file and registry apply in sandboxable target root
notes: Artifact Manager keeps dependency-aware plan support.
Physical side effects are guarded by double-gate: Dry Run? must be false and Apply Changes? must be true.
Controlled apply writes manifest/contract/config, registry, runtime state and installed marker according to operation.
Automatic MacroDroid .ablock/.macro import remains manual/out of scope.
